items.title: NewsNation/DDHQ poll: only 46% of voters trust all midterm votes will be counted accurately
items.summary: Exclusive NewsNation-Decision Desk HQ poll (TrueDot.ai, n=974 likely voters, Oct 5-9, MoE +/-3.2), released Tuesday, Oct 13: 46% believe all midterm votes will be counted accurately; 27% are concerned only about mail-in ballots; 14% believe Republicans will change the count, 13% believe Democrats will. 22% say distrust makes them more determined to vote to 'overwhelm fraud'; 3% say it demoralizes them. DDHQ's Skelley: both parties distrust the count now. Corroborated Newsmax (Rep-leaning) + The Hill (independent) — confirmed.

items.event_time_ist: Oct 13, 2026 (weekly release; LV series began fielding Sept 18-21)
items.title: Economist/YouGov: Democrats lead generic ballot 52-38 among likely voters (D+14), largest lead of the series
items.summary: Latest Economist/YouGov release: Democrats 52, Republicans 38 among likely voters (+14 — largest lead in the three weeks since YouGov began LV modeling; 93% Dem / 90% GOP loyalty, Independents 2-to-1 Dem, women +29 Dem, college-grad Dems +22). Among registered voters: Dems 45-38 (+7, largest since spring 2025). Senate named-candidate ballot: Dems 53-42 (+11). Trump net approval -27 (34% approve/61% disapprove). The D+14 is the bluest LV read of the cycle — aggregators sit lower (RCP +8.3, Silver Bulletin +8.9). Pollster release paired with RCP/Silver Bulletin averages — confirmed.
